messages:
Alex: Quick standup on the postmortem follow-ups for the observability incident (missing spans -> bad aggregation + ETL lag). Ill list action items below. Please ack + owner + ETA.

Maria: Ack. Ill own ETL lag RCA and mitigation plan. ETA 12 business days (target 2026-04-07). Starting with consumer logs and partition replay.

Sam: Ill take aggregation correctness: fix boundary-window off-by-one and add deterministic bucket tests. ETA 5 business days (2026-03-30).

Jen: Ill own span-loss detector, dashboard alerts, and runbook edits. Adding alert thresholds and oncall paging steps.

Olivia: Ill draft a safe backfill plan and staging validation. Will coordinate with Sam for the agg fix before running prod backfill.

Alex: Created Jira cards: RD-9120 (ETL lag RCA + fixes), RD-9121 (aggregation correctness + tests), RD-9122 (span-loss detector + runbook), RD-9123 (backfill plan + verification). Ill link PRs and set weekly check-ins.

IncidentBot: Note: recurring pattern detected  span-loss during batch boundary observed 4 times in last 120 days. Tagging issue with `recurring-observability-gap`.

Sam: Example of problematic query we saw: ```sql
SELECT span_id, count(*) FROM spans WHERE service = 'ingest' GROUP BY span_id;
``` Needs time_bucket partitioning + strict partition key to avoid double counts at boundaries.

Maria: Preliminary RCA: consumer v2 ack race when commit crosses partition cutoff leads to dropped in-flight records. Repro: `./dev/repro_ingest --case=partition-boundary`. Proposed: add idempotent checkpointing + commit buffering.

Jen: Monitoring plan: add metric `spans.missing_rate` and alert if >0.3% over 15m. Dashboard + locking runbook steps (what to do, who to page). Adding a short postmortem checklist to RD-9122.

Olivia: Draft backfill SQL for staging: ```sql
-- staged backfill (checksum-safe)
WITH deltas AS (
  SELECT agg_key, SUM(delta) AS delta
  FROM span_deltas
  WHERE processed_at BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-23'
  GROUP BY agg_key
)
UPDATE aggregates a
SET count = a.count + d.delta
FROM deltas d
WHERE a.key = d.agg_key;
``` Will run in staging and verify checksums.

Sam: Ill pair on staging run. Target prod backfill window: Fri 2026-03-26 02:30 UTC (low traffic). Need infra approval for 2x temp storage and backup snapshot.

Alex: Blockers: Legal/PII for reprocessing, infra quota. Anything else?

Maria: LegalOps: confirm whether reprocessing raw spans requires special consent/signoff due to potential PII. @LegalOps please advise.

LegalOps: Were reviewing the data contract and retention flags. Expect definitive guidance by EOD tomorrow. If PII present, we may need redaction step in backfill.

Jen: Adding legal checklist and rollback instructions to RD-9123.

Olivia: Adding `scripts/backfill-verify --env=staging --mode=checksum` to the ticket. Also drafting a small consumer to replay missing spans into a temporary table for validation.

Sam: Once I push the agg PR Ill include unit tests that mock partition boundaries and an integration test against staging snapshots.

Maria: Ill publish an RCA doc with logs, timelines, and repro steps by EOD today so Jira tickets have artifacts.

Alex: Scheduling weekly syncs starting Tue 2026-03-24 10:00 PT. Calendar invite going out. Please post short status notes in #incidents before the meeting.

Sam: Ack. Will post PR link and note any test flakiness.

Maria: Noted. Ill also open a follow-up ticket to track long-term telemetry improvements (sampling, consistency checks).

Jen: :+1:

Olivia: Putting a rollback playbook in RD-9123 in case backfill causes regressions; includes snapshot restore and dedupe plan.

Alex: Thanks team. Closing this thread  continue updates in RD-9120..9123 and #incidents. If blockers pop, ping me or @oncall.
